title: Challenges Encountered and Students' Reactions to Practices Utilized in a General Chemistry Laboratory Course during the COVID-19 Pandemic
reason: Commentary describing asynchronous general-chemistry lab practices (videos, voice-over slides, kitchen experiments) evaluated by student survey comments in two small summer cohorts; no platform measure related to success or a construct.

extraction.design: descriptive commentary with student survey feedback
extraction.population: General Chemistry I lab students, Pace University (summer 2020: 16; summer 2021: 14)
extraction.notes: J. Chem. Educ. 'Commentary'. All data self-report.
